assessment.scope: Two-round fresh-context independent full-chapter B16 reader review across all 30 canonical paragraphs in 4-section order, section headings, public notes, caveats, and cross-chapter interfaces (B08, B14, B15, B17, B18, B20), with complete independent answers to five comprehension and transfer questions.
assessment.findings: Separated B17 two-pollutant epidemiological DALY control from B20 Swiss ecological-scarcity overlapping policy-target selection, added pre-errata AR6 context on EF 3.1 fossil methane 29.8 kg CO2 eq to align with B15, foregrounded the annual/seasonal grid versus hourly smog-compliance boundary, clarified methyl chloroform = 1,1,1-trichloroethane (CAS 71-55-6) versus isomer 1,1,2-trichloroethane (CAS 79-00-5), anchored RIVM 2016-0104 and NO + O3 -> NO2 + O2 titration chemistry, explained equimolar-N NO2 mass scaling (1.53 / 1 / 0.74), and bridged smoothly from the phosphorus single-pathway step back to ammonia/phosphorus and ahead to B17 particulate inhalation.
answers: No single positive scalar maps EF 3.1 kg NMVOC eq to ReCiPe 2016 HOFP or EOFP kg NOx-eq (or HOFP to EOFP) because precursor marginal substitution ratios differ (1:1 vs 1:0.18 vs 1:0.29), reversing rankings for 1 kg NOx vs 2 kg NMVOC across EF and ReCiPe and for 0.25 kg NOx vs 1 kg NMVOC between HOFP and EOFP.

Benelux HOFP_NOx = -0.48 while EOFP_NOx = +0.16 arises from near-source NO titration reducing urban ozone inhalation while downwind photolysis increases growing-season forest/grassland AOT40; four boundaries (2000 reference working point, positive EOFP, positive secondary PM2.5 health burden, and positive acidification/terrestrial/marine eutrophication) prevent reading -0.48 as net environmental or health benefit.

EF 3.1 POF repeats 1.0 and 0.0811 across 720 <location> rows solely so regionalized air LCI flows do not go uncharacterized, whereas Acidification (BE 0.837, NL 0.892, GB 0.729 vs generic 0.74) and Terrestrial eutrophication (2.72, 2.109, 1.084 vs 4.26) reflect genuine EMEP/critical-load country variation.

Full 1 kg precursor mass enters serial/parallel midpoint pathways because each CF is calibrated per 1 kg emitted; genuine errors arise only when summing heterogeneous midpoint units, summing ozone and PM2.5 DALYs without checking two-pollutant epidemiological control, or ignoring overlapping policy-target rules.

Switching from 0.8 kg generic NMVOC to 0.30 kg NOx (thermal oxidizer) flips from B < A in EF 3.1 (0.30 vs 0.80) to B > A in ReCiPe 2016 world averages (HOFP 0.300 vs 0.144; EOFP 0.300 vs 0.232) and back to B < A in Benelux ozone (-0.144 vs +0.552; +0.048 vs +0.880), while requiring mandatory checks on +0.30 kg NOx acidification, terrestrial/marine eutrophication, secondary PM2.5 disease incidence, and combustion CO2.
